method: Developer inspected the preserved enlarged panel, both generated transparent assets, actual native comparison,360/430 ready captures and390 error/pending states. This is a developer visual judgment supported by source/runtime evidence, not a unit-test or coordinate-only inference.

requiredStaticObligations.evidence: Bundled MCR Auth Print OFL derivative: condensed bold outlines, original uppercase I terminals, deterministic ink-edge irregularity. Native FontFace status loaded at all three widths; no system-font dependence for visible Auth display labels.
